text: Have you experienced any headaches, visual changes, or seizures recently? I also need to know if you have a history of high blood pressure or diabetes.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive difficulty walking. I also have Urinary incontinence, Slurred speech, Rigidity in limbs, Mild hand tremor, Orthostatic hypotension.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any visual hallucinations, and has your sleep quality been poor with episodes of acting out dreams? I would like to correlate these symptoms with your neurological exam findings.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Unremarkable. No known chronic diseases. Social history: Occasionally consumes alcohol. Non-smoker. Works as a bank clerk.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the combination of gait disturbance, urinary incontinence, and cognitive/speech changes, I need to rule out structural causes like normal pressure hydrocephalus or a mass effect. REQUEST TEST: Brain MRI.
